questions.question: When the people of Israel met Solomon's son, King Rehoboam, what did they ask him to do?

answers.text: Lighten the burden his father put on them
Build them a new city in the north
Lead them to war against their enemies

questions.question: When King Rehoboam asked the young men who grew up with him for advice, what did they tell him to say about the people's yoke?

answers.text: He would leave it as it is

questions.question: When King Rehoboam refused to listen to Israel, it fulfilled a word God spoke through the prophet Ahijah. Who was it spoken to?
After the Israelites stoned Hadoram, the man in charge of forced labor, what did King Rehoboam do?

answers.text: Fled in his chariot to Jerusalem
Called the elders back for advice
Went out to speak with the crowd
